task: fix the installer's .NET 10 runtime detection false-negative

rootCause.defect1: RegGetSubkeyNames reads SUBKEY names, but the .NET installer records installed versions as VALUE names (REG_DWORD 1, e.g. a value named '10.0.8'). The key has no subkeys, so the loop never executed and detection always returned False.
rootCause.defect2: The key was read from HKLM64 only. On this machine the 64-bit view of ...\x64\sharedfx\Microsoft.WindowsDesktop.App is EMPTY; the populated key is in the 32-bit view.

fix.iss: installer\L-Mechrevo.iss [Code]: RegGetValueNames instead of RegGetSubkeyNames; both HKLM64 and HKLM32 consulted; FindFirst wildcard probe of {commonpf}\dotnet\shared\Microsoft.WindowsDesktop.App\10.* as an independent fallback.
fix.predicate: installer\Test-DotNetDesktopRuntime.ps1 - testable mirror of the decision (Inno Pascal is not unit-testable); -KeyPath / -NoDirectoryFallback let the false case be proven without uninstalling anything.
fix.downloadDiagnostics: TryInstallDesktopRuntime now logs the URL, the expected SHA256, and GetExceptionMessage verbatim (HTTP status / TLS / proxy / redirect / SHA-256 mismatch) instead of a bare 'failed'.

verification.red: RuntimeDetectionTests: 7 of 9 failed before the fix (predicate absent, .iss still used RegGetSubkeyNames/HKLM64 only).
verification.green: RuntimeDetectionTests: 9/9 pass. Predicate on this machine: 'DETECTED Microsoft.WindowsDesktop.App 10.0.8 (x64)', exit 0.
verification.falseCase: With -NoDirectoryFallback and a nonexistent key -> 'MISSING ...', exit 1. With an existing but 10.x-free key (Windows NT\CurrentVersion) -> 'MISSING ...', exit 1. The directory fallback alone (registry pointed at a nonexistent key, fallback enabled) -> 'DETECTED ... (from the shared framework directory)', exit 0.

downloadFailureReason: Not reproducible here: the in-installer download was never exercised on this machine (the runtime is already present, so PrepareToInstall exits early). The concrete reason is now logged verbatim by the fix; the pinned SHA256 is for the immutable versioned blob URL, so a mismatch would indicate a changed artifact rather than a moving target.
runbook: docs\hardware\first-machine-runbook.md Step 10.0 - run installer\Test-DotNetDesktopRuntime.ps1 before installing on a machine that already has .NET 10; expect DETECTED + exit 0, and the installer must not prompt to download.
